task: Create mechanical interface and coordinate-frame register
acceptance_criteria: Trace selected components to hardware_interfaces.csv and requirements; list mounting patterns, motor centers, prop sweep, battery restraint and common body axes. Unknown dimensions and masses remain pending, not guessed release inputs.
verification: Cross-check every component against the existing engineering tables and mass-property template; retain source and units per input.

task: Approve actual component and bench geometry inputs
acceptance_criteria: Supply fit-critical drawings or measurements for motor, props, electronics, battery, load cell and stand, fabrication method and limits. Reconcile any existing Onshape model and define reuse authority; identify qualified bench reviewer.
verification: Record actual part revisions, reviewed envelope and access decisions. Missing dimensions keep downstream fabrication blocked.
blocker: Owner confirms the actual four-motor vehicle, component interfaces, fabrication capability and bench/instrument envelope; later drop-fixture work requires separate readiness approval.

task: Model the full vehicle packaging assembly
deliverable: NEW cad/vehicle/assembly/ (editable source, STEP, layout drawing)
acceptance_criteria: Model motor mounts, frame, electronics/battery retention, connector service space and wire routing using sourced envelopes. Assign mass basis per part; model all four rotor swept envelopes and retained fasteners.
verification: Retain interference report, top/side/section views and service-access checks at the documented configuration.
blocker: Requires completed DR-CAD-02 with its recorded input decisions; no modeling has started.

task: Model guard attachments and analyze geometric load paths
acceptance_criteria: Detail attachment interfaces, joints and minimum prop clearance over declared tolerance/deflection assumptions; distinguish contact guard from blade-fragment containment. Do not claim a CAD guard is impact-qualified.
verification: Inspect worst-case fit and removal/access; link load paths to Analysis/guard.py assumptions and log mismatches for later analysis.
blocker: Requires completed DR-CAD-03 with its recorded input decisions; no modeling has started.

task: Export CAD mass, CG and inertia with source provenance
acceptance_criteria: Use the existing Engineering Data/cad_mass_properties_template.csv columns; document inertia frame, origin, units, products-of-inertia convention, density/source and uncertain bought-part masses. Keep modeled values separate from measured values.
verification: Reconcile component sums with assembly mass; verify frame translations and symmetric/positive inertia; compare current mass budget without silently overwriting assumed inputs.
blocker: Requires completed DR-CAD-03, DR-CAD-04 with its recorded input decisions; no modeling has started.

task: Model propulsion metrology stand and protective interfaces
acceptance_criteria: Specify load-cell mounts, thrust axis, calibrated torque-arm lever, hard mounting/ballast, cable restraint, remote stop access and independent containment interface. Document nominal applied loads and stability calculations; qualified containment is an external input, not a printed-shell claim.
verification: Review calibration-load path, tip-over/sliding/fastener assumptions and prop exclusion envelope against the existing safety checklist. Retain review issues; no energized approval implied.
blocker: Requires completed DR-CAD-02 with its recorded input decisions; no modeling has started.

acceptance_criteria: Define bifilar or trifilar suspension attachment, spacing, suspension-length measurement, body-frame alignment and securing points for a props-off vehicle. Include fixture inertia/tare identification in the measurement plan.
verification: Check support loads and unobstructed small-angle motion; retain dimensioned datums and fixture contribution calculation before an approved calibration run.
blocker: Requires completed DR-CAD-02, DR-CAD-05 with its recorded input decisions; no modeling has started.

task: Release vehicle and bench manufacturing-review pack
deliverable: NEW cad/release/ (BOM, drawings, source/export manifest, inspection plan)
acceptance_criteria: Include vehicle/bench revisions, material/process and critical fits, assembly/exploded views and inspection checks. List mass-property physical validation and safety approval as unresolved until observed; preserve 0.020 N m and 962/1000 gates.
verification: Reopen neutral exports, compare selected dimensions and mass against native source; review every critical interface and hardware-data dependency.
blocker: Requires completed DR-CAD-04, DR-CAD-05, DR-CAD-06, DR-CAD-07 with its recorded input decisions; no modeling has started.

deliverable: NEW cad/bench/release-fixture/ (source and reviewed concept drawing)
acceptance_criteria: Only after qualified operator approves a bounded recovery campaign and measured propulsion readiness exists: define restraint, release clearance and common trigger/visible-LED mounts. No free-flight claim or test authorization from CAD.
verification: Review prop/vehicle trajectory envelope and release-failure modes with the facility; record approval separately from geometry.
blocker: Out of the initial CAD phase; promote only after the recorded trigger and owner review.
